supplemental_data.retrieval_method: manual numeric transcription from official CBS HTML release; not direct API ingestion
caveats: All observations are January–September cumulative periods; none is a full calendar-year observation.
2026 values are provisional and may be revised.
Values are rounded to one decimal thousand persons.
Origin panel includes only the ten origins selected as highest net migration in the 2026 Jan–September release.
CBS release label 'country of origin' is preserved; do not infer nationality or country of birth.

workflow_audit.note: A push-triggered full refresh will be used as a corrective execution because the 7 November schedule-triggered run was not visible at the audit cutoff. This does not repair cron reliability.

model.note: No EOM equations or weights changed. CBS YTD panel is supplementary and excluded from annual macro ranking and annual backtest.
